title: Pokemon RPG Protagonists
author: Dark-Warrior-Minerva
description:
So, I was inspired by and decided to create my own fantasy RPG based off the Pokemon games in RPG Maker MV! I'm currently calling it Pokemon: The Gemstones of Destiny and it's a game largely akin to an early Final Fantasy title, where you control a party of heroes traveling around a magical world, fighting enemies, and attempting to stop the main villain (in this case Lusamine) from collecting eight mystical gemstones in an attempt to become a god. I know, rather cliche, but I'm enjoying it.

These are the characters I've created in the MV character generator to be the party of playable characters. From left to right, they are: Selene (f!protag from Sun and Moon) as the party leader and a 'spellblade', which is essentially a magic knight character class; Hau as a sorcerer, which is akin to a black mage character class; Lillie as a priestess, which basically functions as a white mage character class; and Gladion as a paladin.

I plan to create some more Pokemon game characters to serve as NPCs. I've already created Elio (m!protag of Sun and Moon), Calem and Serena character sprites and facesets, and intend to create more once I figure out how to add more parts to the generator. I definitely plan to create a child Wally character and an Emperor Red character (and yes, he does actually talk!) once I figure that out.

I also plan to release side view battler images of the hero party with more detailed profiles of the characters eventually. Stay tuned for that!

title: MV Tiles A2: Castle Walls and Carpets
author: That-Hime-Kun
description:
I thought I should maybe veer a bit back into making tilesets, and decided since I pretty much stopped working on these (I don't really like the color palette but am too lazy to change it) I might as well upload them! Some tiles are 24x24 based while others go straight for 48x48. There's a total of three parts to this: A2 (tiles that use a grid as basis), A5 (normal tiles) and B (objects etc); named as such since that's what the MV calls them.

The regular grounds and walls aren't really made for this tiling, but at first I had only made this one file and didn't wanna make another one just for the normal stuff.

I had a lot of both agony and fun with the carpets. On one hand, since they're carpets you could put any kind of desing on them, and on the other that was exactly my problem at first: Not knowing what pattern they should have. I first tried a really simple boring one that isn't even included with these as I never even colored it. I then tried making random lines to emulate some kind of filigran lines, and later opted for a rose petal theme. And then I tried a more geometrical pattern, but since I couldn't decide on one version of it, I made it three: Solid blocks, the lines of each block shining through and just the lines on a dark background.

Free to use, whether it's the RPG Maker MV or not, and free to recolor as well since not even I am happy with the pallette. It'd be nice if you showed me where you used them, of course...

title: Tileset Addon Stone Bridge
author: Sevarihk
description:
This is a tileset addon I made for my (not yet finished) ruin/temple/dungeon tilesets. It's formatted for RPG Maker XP (or any tilemap that uses 32x32 tiles) and can be made as long as you like if you repeat the middle part. It comes with a broken version and a few wooden planks if you want your players to be able to "fix" it.

The WIP-Tileset it goes with (though you may use it in any tileset you like) can be found here: aurora-sprites.wixsite.com/mai…
(Right now my homepage is only in German, but I am working on the English version)

Terms of Use:
- free to use in any commercial or non-commercial project
- you can edit as much as you like
- Credit goes to me ("Sevarihk" or "Aurora")
- You may repost if you mention it's my work and link to my original post/my homepage
